nodes.title: Transfer aliquot
nodes.description: Pour the configured aliquot of stock solution from the graduated cylinder into the volumetric flask.

feedback.retry: Review Transfer aliquot and try again.

nodes.title: Dilute to mark
nodes.description: Add deionized water from the wash bottle to bring the volumetric flask to the configured final volume.

feedback.retry: Review Dilute to mark and try again.

nodes.title: Record dilution
nodes.description: Record the the configured dilution factor in the notebook.

feedback.retry: Review Record dilution and try again.
